candidates.change_summary: Remove the check for the IERC1155 interface id, so callers querying type(IERC1155).interfaceId now get false instead of true.
Remove the check for the IERC1155MetadataURI interface id, so callers querying type(IERC1155MetadataURI).interfaceId now get false instead of true.
Remove the super.supportsInterface disjunct, so callers querying type(IERC165).interfaceId now get false instead of true.
Swap the mapping key order in the return so it reads _balances[account][id] instead of _balances[id][account].
Replace the return statement so it always returns 0 instead of the stored balance.
Insert a statement that shifts the queried account by one address before the lookup, so a different account's balance is returned.
